baseline_prompt_en: Make a legible, visually complex fashion-editorial test on a night ferry vehicle deck converted into a textile lab at fog-filtered high noon. A clearly adult 32-year-old woman whose facial appearance follows the adult facial-appearance reference is a sound artist tuning a hand-cranked ribbon resonator. She deliberately turns the hand crank with her right hand while her left hand sets the ribbon tension; moving ribbons and a compact anemometer make her chosen adjustment visibly causal. Her feet form a stable support path, weight settled over the rear foot, torso upright, shoulders open yet restrained. She pauses within the action to meet the lens with alert level eyes and a small controlled closed-lip expression. She wears an opaque copper-brown silk-faille column dress with a controlled side fold; deck airflow draws its weighted hem into a clean diagonal, crisp seam edges remain readable, and a warm highlight travels across the drape as her torso turns. Weighted silk swatches sit beside the instrument. Photograph a vertical medium-full portrait on an 80 mm lens from waist height, with pale fog light interrupted by rotating bands of warm machinery light, realistic texture, and a polished non-explicit adult fashion-editorial finish.
